subject: Solstice Analytics — scheduling a product walkthrough
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@solsticeanalytics.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-09-12T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up from the Solstice webinar — 30 min walkthrough?

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for joining our "Inference at Scale" webinar this morning — really appreciate you tuning in. I wanted to follow up and offer a short, focused walkthrough of the Redwood platform tailored to the use cases you flagged (on-prem options and data residency).

We usually keep this to 30 minutes: quick product tour + 10 minutes for your questions. A couple of options if any of these work for you:
- Mon 9/15 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue 9/16 11:30–12:00 PT
- Wed 9/17 14:00–14:30 PT

Or you can pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min

I’ve looped in Markus (AE) so he can cover any platform/architecture items you want to dive into. If there’s someone from security you want on the call, let me know and we’ll include them.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Development Rep | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Solstice-Agenda.pdf (PDF) — demo objectives & suggested agenda]
From: Priya Sharma <priya@solsticeanalytics.com>

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from the Solstice webinar — 30 min walkthrough?

Hi Ben,

Thanks — yes, I watched the webinar and would like to learn more. A few notes so we can make the session productive:
- We’re particularly interested in your private deployment options and whether Redwood supports on-prem or customer VPCs for model serving.
- Data residency and KMS integrations are a must for us; I’d like to speak to someone who can confirm encryption and audit log details.
- 30–45 minutes is fine; can we aim for a time later in the week? I’m in PT.

Proposed window: Thu 9/18 or Fri 9/19 afternoon (PT). Any chance Markus or someone from the security/product team can join?

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Head of Engineering — Solstice Analytics
priya@solsticeanalytics.com

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-09-12T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from the Solstice webinar — 30 min walkthrough?

Hi Priya — great to meet you (virtually). I’m the AE who will run the walkthrough. Thanks for the timing preferences and the clear ask.

Short answers up front:
- Redwood supports both hosted and Private (VPC/on-prem packaged) deployments. We integrate with customer KMS providers and provide audit logs and exportable retention policies.
- I’ve attached a one-pager for security basics; Monica (CC’d) is our CS lead and can join to cover logging/retention details.

If Thu/Fri afternoons are best for you, I can do any of these slots (PT):
- Thu 9/18 13:30–14:15 PT
- Thu 9/18 15:00–15:45 PT
- Fri 9/19 14:00–14:45 PT

Please pick whichever works and I’ll send a calendar invite and short agenda. If you prefer, book here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min (I’ll extend to 45 mins if needed).

Attachments:
- Redwood-Security-OnePager.pdf (security summary)
- Solstice-Agenda.pdf (tailored agenda)

Best regards,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Redwood-Security-OnePager.pdf (PDF)]

Hi Markus,

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround and the security doc. The Thu slots are tricky for our leadership; could we please move to Fri 9/19 14:00–14:45 PT? That should give us time to pull in our security engineer (Anita Shah) for the second half.

Also, can you confirm whether you have any customer case studies for regulated data workloads? If so, please share ahead of the call.

Best,
Priya
